title: Brazil — CAR Property Boundaries (Área do Imóvel)
description:
Property boundaries (`Area do Imovel`) from the Brazilian Rural Environmental Registry (Cadastro Ambiental Rural, CAR), national coverage, updated as of July 16, 2026. 8,453,552 polygons after quarantining 2 corrupt geometries (see below). Every row carries the single theme `Area do Imovel`; the other CAR theme layers are not in this catalog.

`cod_imovel` is the CAR registration code and the join key to the CAR theme layers. It is **not unique** here: 8,453,552 rows carry 8,437,938 distinct values, so 15,614 rows repeat a code that another row also carries. Deduplicate before you count properties.

Other attributes: state code (`cod_estado`), municipality (`municipio`), administrative condition (`des_condic`, 16 distinct values), property type (`ind_tipo`: `IRU` rural property, `AST` agrarian reform settlement, `PCT` traditional territory), number of fiscal modules (`mod_fiscal`), declared area (`num_area`) and registry dates (`dat_criaca`, `dat_atuali`).

Reprojected from EPSG:4674 (SIRGAS 2000) to EPSG:4326 and rewritten as a single cloud-native GeoParquet 1.1 file: a bbox covering column for row-group pruning, ZSTD compression, and 212 row groups sized for HTTP range requests.

Two source geometries had corrupt coordinates far outside Brazil (one in Sao Luis/MA reaching a latitude of 239,000,000; one in Itabaiana/SE at longitude 89) and could not be reprojected to a sensible location. They are kept, unmodified, in the sidecar asset `suspect` (`brazil_car_area_imovel_suspect.parquet`) rather than dropped, so no `cod_imovel` is lost.
